name: Mouse
overview: The Bible presents the mouse in diverse roles, highlighting its status as an unclean creature forbidden as food (Leviticus 11:29; Isaiah 66:17) and its association with plagues and destruction in the land of the Philistines. The golden images of mice crafted by the Philistines symbolize their recognition of God's power to afflict and heal (1 Samuel 6:4-5, 11, 18). These references emphasize God's sovereign authority over all creation, using even small creatures like mice to fulfill His purposes and call His people to holiness.
